summary: Correctly broadens the InheritDocstrings type check from `inspect.isfunction` to also include `inspect.isdatadescriptor`, which matches property objects and resolves the reported issue with a minimal, general fix. The only extra change is harmless removal of stray blank lines.

issues.description: Removal of blank lines after the module docstring and before `__all__` is unrelated whitespace cleanup, slightly outside the scope of the property fix, but cosmetically harmless.

`inspect.isdatadescriptor` matches all data descriptors (property + objects with __get__/__set__), not only properties; this is the intended generalization and the public-member + `__doc__ is None` filters keep it safe, but it is slightly broader than the literal issue.
